response.query: What precise hypothesis tests, surrogate procedures, and threshold rules (e.g., bootstrap CI, surrogate p-value) will we use to accept or reject a claim of low-dimensional chaos?
response.answer: To test for low-dimensional chaos, use bootstrap confidence intervals and surrogate procedures. A p-value < 0.05 typically indicates rejection of the null hypothesis of no chaos.
